items.name: Settlement Flag
items.description: A chartered trading company flag. Plant in an unsettled Area to claim it.

items.name: Tent
items.description: Required for sleeping in the field.

items.name: Campfire Kit
items.description: Flint, steel, and a small grate. Required to make a campfire.

items.name: Field Alchemy Set
items.description: Portable distillation equipment. Required for field alchemy.

items.name: Compass
items.description: Shows cardinal direction. Standard-issue for all surveyors.

items.name: Field Journal
items.description: Your personal journal. Records creatures, ingredients, sites, and notes.

items.name: Spyglass
items.description: Extends visual survey range to medium distance.

items.name: Theodolite
items.description: Precision surveying instrument. Long range resource identification.

items.name: Bandage
items.description: Stops bleeding. Field treatment.

items.name: Splint
items.description: Stabilizes broken bones and damaged limbs. Field treatment.

items.name: Healing Potion
items.description: Restores 40 health over 10 seconds.

items.name: Stamina Draft
items.description: Restores 50 stamina instantly.

items.name: Antidote
items.description: Clears poison and venom effects.

items.name: Thermal Tonic
items.description: Widens temperature comfort range for 5 minutes.

items.name: Monster Repellent
items.description: Reduces detection range of nearby monsters for 3 minutes.

items.name: Raw Meat
items.description: Edible but risky uncooked. Cook it.

items.name: Cooked Meat
items.description: Satisfying. Cook at campfire from raw meat.

items.name: Hardtack
items.description: Dense, dry ration. Lasts forever. Barely satisfying.

items.name: Waterskin
items.description: Holds water. Fill at streams and rivers.

items.name: Snare Trap
items.description: Sets a trap for small game. Check after sleeping.

items.name: Iron Scraps
items.description: Raw iron. Used for repairs and crafting.

items.name: Leather Scraps
items.description: Scraps of cured hide. Used for repairs.

items.name: Sulfur
items.description: Yellow mineral. Required for black powder.

items.name: Map
items.description: A hand-drawn map. Shows terrain and settlements. Does not show your position.
